sentence: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.

source.author: Henry David Thoreau
source.detail: 第二章 "Where I Lived, and What I Lived For"

translation: 我走进森林，是因为我想从容、有意识地生活，只去面对生活中最本质的东西，看看自己能否学到生活要教给我的道理，免得到了临终之时，才发现自己从未真正活过。
grammar: 主干是 I went to the woods，后面是 because 引导的原因状语从句；wished 后接一串并列不定式（to live / (to) front / (to) see / not (to) discover），后几个 to 省略。否定不定式 not 放在 to do 前。
when I came to die 中 come to do 意为“到了……的时候”；discover that I had not lived 用过去完成时，表示“过去的过去”。

vocab.meaning: 面对、直面（较古典，现代多用 confront）

vocab.example: Sleep is essential for good health.
I came to realize that practice matters more than talent.
Let me see if the code compiles.

note: 写代码也一样，deliberately 地去做，比赶工更有收获。
